sources.entry: feature-engine - sklearn-compatible API with the widest toolset for feature engineering and selection.

summary.one_liner: Feature-engine is a Python library of scikit-learn-style transformers for engineering and selecting features for machine learning models.
summary.what_it_does: Provides a large set of transformers that learn parameters from data with fit() and transform(), following the scikit-learn API. Covered areas include missing data imputation, categorical encoding, discretisation, outlier capping or removal, variable transformation and scaling, and variable creation. It also offers feature selection methods such as dropping constant, duplicate or correlated features, recursive feature elimination and addition, MRMR, and probe feature selection. Additional transformers handle datetime features, text features, time series lag and window features, and preprocessing that matches categories or variables. It includes a Pipeline and make_pipeline, plus a SklearnWrapper.
use_cases: fill in missing values in a pandas dataset before modelling
encode categorical variables for a machine learning model
select the most useful features for a predictive model
cap or remove outliers in training data
create lag and window features for time series forecasting
generate datetime or cyclical features from raw columns
notable: Transformers follow the scikit-learn fit()/transform() API and can be used inside scikit-learn pipelines
Very broad coverage: imputation, encoding, discretisation, outliers, transformation, creation, and selection in one library
Includes feature selection methods such as MRMR, recursive feature elimination, probe feature selection, and drop high PSI features
Time series transformers for lag, window, and expanding window features
caveats: README does not state platform or version limits beyond Python package installation via pip or conda
Some features are documented only through external docs and notebook gallery, which the README links rather than shows
keywords: prepare data for a machine learning model
